origins.section: A Pool Queues Before It Grows: Threads Past the Core Start Only When the Queue Is Full
execute() Hands a Task's Exception to the Thread; submit() Keeps It in the Future
shutdown() Stops Intake, Not Work: Wait for It With awaitTermination()
A Pool's Size Is Also a Limit on Concurrency, and Some Executors Have None

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-core-sixteen: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-core-sixteen: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-core-sixteen: The page says that at the core size a task goes into the queue and only when the queue refuses it does the pool start a thread past the core, so 46 reports in a queue of 500 leave the pool at 4 threads (option d).
recorded.prompt:q-reconcile-submit: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconcile-submit: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reconcile-submit: The page shows the submitted task threw inside FutureTask.run(), which stored the exception in the Future, nothing was printed, and only get() shows the failure, so a dropped Future leaves no trace (option a).
recorded.prompt:q-hook-closes-datasource: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hook-closes-datasource: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-hook-closes-datasource: The page describes this exact case: a hook that calls pool.shutdown() and then closes the database connections breaks the queued tasks, because they run after shutdown() returns against closed connections (option b).
recorded.prompt:q-geocoder-virtual: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-geocoder-virtual: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-geocoder-virtual: The page says newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor() starts a virtual thread per task with no limit (all 1,000 queries ran together) and that replacing a fixed pool removes the limit the downstream relied on, so the vendor sees up to 300 (option b).

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-core-sixteen:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-core-sixteen:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-core-sixteen:a: The page states and shows the opposite order: tasks past the core are queued first (task 3 and 4 queued at threads=2), and extra threads start only when the queue is full.
recorded.prompt:q-core-sixteen:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-core-sixteen:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-core-sixteen:b: The page defines keep-alive as how long a thread past the core may stay idle before it ends, and gives the queue refusing a task as the only trigger for starting a thread past the core.
recorded.prompt:q-core-sixteen:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-core-sixteen:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-core-sixteen:c: The page's rule starts threads past the core only when the queue refuses a task, and its 10,000-task burst on an unbounded queue stayed at 8 threads, so a burst alone starts no extra threads.
recorded.prompt:q-reconcile-submit:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconcile-submit:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reconcile-submit:b: The page shows the worker does not catch task exceptions: the execute() exception ended the worker thread and was printed by the default handler, while for submit() it was FutureTask that caught it.
recorded.prompt:q-reconcile-submit:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconcile-submit:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reconcile-submit:c: The page says the submitted task's exception was caught by FutureTask and 'Nothing was printed'; only the execute() task reached the thread's default handler.
recorded.prompt:q-reconcile-submit:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reconcile-submit:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reconcile-submit:d: The page says the hooks do nothing by default and shows afterExecute receiving thrown=null for a submitted task.
recorded.prompt:q-hook-closes-datasource:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hook-closes-datasource:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-hook-closes-datasource:a: The page shows shutdown() kept the queued tasks and they still ran (ran=4), and says it is shutdownNow() that hands back the queued ones.
recorded.prompt:q-hook-closes-datasource:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hook-closes-datasource:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-hook-closes-datasource:c: The page shows shutdown() refused only the newly submitted task while the three already queued still ran.
recorded.prompt:q-hook-closes-datasource:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hook-closes-datasource:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-hook-closes-datasource:d: The page says shutdown() returned at once (isTerminated=false, ran=0) and that awaitTermination is what waits.
recorded.prompt:q-geocoder-virtual:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-geocoder-virtual:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-geocoder-virtual:a: The page says a waiting virtual thread gives its carrier back so the number of tasks needs no pool to cap it, and shows 1,000 queries in flight at once, which rules out a cap at the old pool size.
recorded.prompt:q-geocoder-virtual:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-geocoder-virtual:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-geocoder-virtual:c: The page says the virtual-thread executor starts a virtual thread per task, has no limit, and that the move removes the old pool's limit.
recorded.prompt:q-geocoder-virtual:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-geocoder-virtual:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-geocoder-virtual:d: The page states a virtual thread that waits gives its carrier thread back, contradicting a carrier held for the whole call.
